title: Tarawera Ultra-Trail by UTMB — T102 race page (13 February 2027)
claims: The T102 starts at Firmin Field, Kawerau at 07:00 on Saturday 13 February 2027, covers 102 km with 2,300 m of positive gain and has a maximum allowed time of 30 hours.
The T102 is a point-to-point course from Kawerau to Rotorua taking in 5 lakes, and the page states that the T102 is a UTMB Worlds Series 100K Event with 3 running stones.
The T102 has 8 aid stations along its route and no pacer option.
The T102 entry price is NZ$600 on the race page, while the entry page lists NZ$625.

The T102 aid-station table lists 10 rows from Firmin Field (0 km) to Village Green (101.9 km), and the same page's drop-bag table gives Okataina 57.3 km, Tikitapu 84.5 km and Village Green 101.6 km against 57.5 km, 84.8 km and 101.9 km in the aid table.
